provider: BEAN Intelligence local inference (onnxruntime-node CPU EP)
modelIdentity: ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 cross-encoder (query/passage pair scoring, sigmoid relevance), int8 quantized ONNX

capabilities.scoring: sigmoid(single logit) per (query, passage) pair — real forward passes, not keyword heuristics
capabilities.ordering: descending relevance; candidate cap 8 pairs per request keeps CPU bounded
capabilities.tokenizer: BERT WordPiece (pinned vocab.txt), pair truncation keeps the query at half the budget minimum
capabilities.languageLimitation: trained on MS MARCO (English); non-English pairs score poorly and the retrieval lane says so in its limitations

limits.integrity: install refuses any artifact whose bytes/SHA-256 mismatch the manifest; the lane is never 'ready' unless every artifact verifies

verifiedProbes.test: score('How many people live in Berlin?', population passage) vs (Metropolitan Museum passage)
verifiedProbes.latencyMs: session load 87 ms; per-pair inference tens of ms (CPU)
verifiedProbes.measured: relevant=0.9998; irrelevant=0.0000; ordering correct with wide margin
